note: Curated candidates for the Expert (GitHub) edition only. Downloading and installing these is not available in the Play build: fetching executable code from a non-Play source is prohibited by the Device and Network Abuse policy (docs/distribution.md 2.1, D1). The Play build may list them for reference, and first-party plugins may be bundled in the APK instead. M14 re-checked the 19 'unavailable' entries: 7 are on PyPI under a different distribution name than their catalog id, and 12 are not published on PyPI at all. Repository URLs were filled in from awesome-beancount.com on 2026-08-27; for the twelve not published on PyPI that is the only way to obtain them, and the Expert edition installs from a file the user supplies.

status_meaning.supported: install, import, execute and round-trip all passed on a real run
status_meaning.needs-config: works, but the plugin directive must carry a configuration string
status_meaning.partial: some steps passed; the failing step is recorded in `tested.reason`
status_meaning.unsupported: a step failed; the reason is recorded
status_meaning.unavailable: could not be fetched or contains no loadable plugin; nothing was run
status_meaning.untested: listed only; no compatibility claim is made
